# RecruiterReply

> RecruiterReply helps job seekers understand recruiter messages, draft professional responses, compare job offers, and prepare for salary negotiations.

## Public pages

- [RecruiterReply homepage](https://recruiterreply.com/)
- [Recruiter reply tools](https://recruiterreply.com/seo-recruiter-replies.html)
- [Job offer comparison](https://recruiterreply.com/seo-job-offer-comparison.html)
- [Salary negotiation](https://recruiterreply.com/seo-salary-negotiation.html)

## Notes

AI-powered features require an account. This file provides public page references, not private user data.
